home.title: From command to interface — a complete practice ecosystem
home.desc: Practice Plan is a user-driven, multilingual, open-source development framework linking the PPC command system, connectors, and desktop tools — turning every interaction into a perceptible experience.

card1.title: User-Driven Development
card1.desc: Every evolution stems from real use cases and community feedback. Needs drive features; experience defines priorities — letting the product grow through real practice.

card2.title: Multilingual Support
card2.desc: Native support for 中文, English, Français, Русский, العربية — auto-detects system language and switches the interface and RTL layout in real time.

card3.title: Open Source
card3.desc: Open code, clear license, contributions welcome. From PPC to TOP_APP — building an auditable, extensible practice ecosystem.

contact.title: Feedback / Contact Us
contact.sub: Have a thought? Let it flow.
